providers.description: Open data of the city Umeå in northen Sweden

providers.name: Candela
providers.description: Candela is a Swedish manufacturer of electric hydrofoiling boats and ferries, on a mission to decarbonize waterborne transportation. Its proprietary computer-controlled hydrofoil system, C-Pod electric propulsion, and C-Foil technology lift the hull clear of the water to cut energy consumption by roughly 80% versus conventional planing hulls, enabling silent, long-range, zero-emission travel. Products span leisure craft (the C-8 and C-7 dayboats) and professional vessels (the P-12 electric ferry and shuttle for public and commercial transport). Backed by EQT Ventures, Candela is a hardware and mobility company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This record captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Conapto
providers.description: Conapto provides scalable, secure and sustainable data center colocation and cloud connectivity services. Based in Sweden, Conapto offers flexible colocation solutions, interconnect, cloud‑connect, and sale‑leaseback options for enterprises seeking reliable infrastructure with low carbon footprint. The company emphasizes climate‑responsible operations, high availability, and competitive electricity costs, serving customers across Europe and globally.

providers.name: SL Storstockholms Lokaltrafik
providers.description: SL Storstockholms Lokaltrafik (SL) is the public transport authority for Stockholm County in Sweden, operating buses, metros, commuter trains, trams and ferries. It provides travel planning, ticketing, real‑time departure information and service updates for millions of passengers each year. While its primary focus is on passenger services, SL also offers data feeds and APIs for developers to integrate schedule, stop, and route information into third‑party applications, supporting open data initiatives and smart mobility solutions.

providers.name: Riksbank
providers.description: Riksbank, Sveriges Riksbank, is Sweden's central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, and issuing currency. It provides statistical data and APIs for interest rates, exchange rates, and financial market statistics, supporting developers and researchers with programmatic access to economic indicators.

providers.name: AAK
providers.description: AAK AB is a Swedish producer of value-adding plant-based oils and fats, headquartered in Malmö and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ticker AAK) in the Food & Beverage large-cap segment. It was formed in 2005 through the merger of Denmark's Aarhus United and Sweden's Karlshamns AB, and describes more than 150 years of combined experience in specialty vegetable oils. The company employs roughly 4,000 people across 19 production facilities, 25 regional sales offices and 16 Customer Innovation Centers, and works through a co-development model with customers in chocolate and confectionery, bakery, dairy and ice cream, plant-based foods, special nutrition, foodservice and retail, personal care, animal nutrition, candles and technical products such as fatty acids and glycerine. Its product is a physical industrial ingredient, not software: no developer program, public API, SDK, developer portal, machine-readable contract or GitHub organization could be found, and no api/developer/docs/portal hostname resolves under aak.com.

providers.name: Finansinspektionen
providers.description: Finansinspektionen is Sweden’s financial supervisory authority, responsible for overseeing banks, insurance companies, securities firms and other financial institutions. It works to ensure market stability, protect consumers, enforce regulations, and promote transparency in the financial sector. The agency publishes reports, guidelines, and registers, and provides public data and resources related to financial supervision and compliance.

providers.name: Folkhalsomyndigheten (Public Health Agency of Sweden)
providers.description: Folkhalsomyndigheten (Public Health Agency of Sweden) is Sweden’s national public health agency, responsible for public health surveillance, disease prevention, health promotion, and providing evidence-based guidance. It publishes statistics, data, reports, and guidance for healthcare professionals and the public, and operates open data portals and APIs for health data access.

providers.name: Sobi (Swedish Orphan Biovitrum)
providers.description: Sobi (Swedish Orphan Biovitrum) is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative medicines for rare diseases. The company aims to transform the lives of patients with rare and ultra‑rare conditions through a robust pipeline of therapies, extensive research, and collaborations worldwide. Sobi operates from its headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, and maintains a presence across Europe and the United States, delivering treatments in hematology, immunology, and neurology.

providers.name: Svenska kraftnät
providers.description: Svenska kraftnät is Sweden’s national transmission system operator, responsible for the safe and efficient operation of the country’s high‑voltage electricity grid. It ensures reliable power delivery, balances supply and demand, and coordinates cross‑border electricity exchanges. The agency also provides information on system status, market operations, and regulatory frameworks, supporting both industry stakeholders and the public.

providers.name: Livsmedelsverket (Swedish Food Agency)
providers.description: Livsmedelsverket, the Swedish Food Agency, is a government authority responsible for food safety, nutrition, and consumer information in Sweden. It develops regulations, conducts research, and provides guidance to ensure safe and healthy food for the public, covering areas such as food labeling, contaminants, and dietary advice.

providers.name: Riksdagen
providers.description: Riksdagen (Swedish Parliament) is the national legislature of Sweden, responsible for lawmaking, overseeing the government, and representing the Swedish people. The official website provides information about parliamentary work, members, legislation, debates, and public services. It serves as a portal for citizens to access documents, watch live sessions, and engage with democratic processes.

providers.name: Skatteverket
providers.description: Skatteverket is Sweden’s national tax authority, responsible for tax collection, registration, and enforcement for individuals and businesses. It provides a wide range of e‑services, including tax filing, personal identification numbers, and information on duties and benefits. The agency aims to simplify tax processes through digital services and transparent communication with the public.

providers.name: Länsförsäkringar
providers.description: Länsförsäkringar is a Swedish financial services group offering banking, insurance, loans, savings and pension products. It operates regionally across Sweden, providing digital and physical services to private customers and businesses. The company’s website presents extensive information about its offerings, corporate governance, sustainability initiatives, and customer support.

providers.name: Trygg-Hansa
providers.description: Trygg-Hansa is a Swedish insurance company offering a wide range of insurance products for individuals and businesses, including car, home, travel, health, and life insurance. The company focuses on providing reliable coverage and customer service, leveraging digital channels for policy management and claims handling. As part of the API Evangelist network, its digital presence includes a public website and customer portals, though detailed API specifications are not publicly documented at this time.

providers.name: Lakemedelsverket (Swedish Medical Products Agency)
providers.description: Lakemedelsverket (Swedish Medical Products Agency) is a Swedish governmental authority responsible for promoting public and animal health concerning medicines, medical devices, and cosmetics. It oversees the regulation, approval, and monitoring of pharmaceuticals and related products to ensure safety and efficacy for the Swedish population.

providers.name: Mathem
providers.description: Mathem is Sweden's largest pure-play online grocery retailer, delivering fresh food, household goods and pantry staples directly to consumers' homes across Sweden. Customers browse and order the full assortment of a physical supermarket through the mathem.se website and native iOS/Android apps, and receive scheduled home delivery. Mathem merged with the Norwegian online grocer Oda to form one of the Nordics' largest online grocery groups, and its security and careers functions are now operated under the shared Oda organization. Payments are handled through Klarna and the major card networks. Mathem operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and mobile apps; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal. This API Evangelist profile was created as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio lead and enriched via the enrichment pipeline; the substantive public technical surface found is an RFC 9116 security.txt and an invite-only YesWeHack bug-bounty program run through Oda.

providers.name: Eneryield
providers.description: Eneryield is a Gothenburg, Sweden based company (a Techstars portfolio company) building AI-powered fault prediction and analytics for electric power systems. Its flagship product, Eneryield IntelliView, uses explainable AI to forecast power outages before they occur by analyzing voltage and current signals from digital relays and merging units on overhead lines, underground cables, and underwater cables. The cloud-based platform integrates directly into existing utility monitoring systems without additional hardware, giving grid operators transparent root-cause analysis so they can move to proactive maintenance and reduce operational cost and downtime. As of this profile, Eneryield publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures its identity and infrastructure posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ICA Gruppen
providers.description: ICA Gruppen is a leading Swedish retail and service conglomerate operating supermarkets, pharmacies, banks, and real estate. It focuses on sustainable growth, digital innovation, and customer convenience across Scandinavia, offering a wide range of products and services while emphasizing environmental responsibility and community engagement.

providers.name: Inera
providers.description: Inera is a Swedish digitalization company that works on behalf of municipalities and regions to develop and maintain digital services for the welfare sector. It provides platforms such as 1177 Vårdguiden, NLL (National Patient Overview), and various digital portals for citizens, healthcare professionals, and public administrations. Inera focuses on secure, interoperable, and user‑centric solutions that enable access to health information, appointment booking, and other public services through modern web and mobile applications.

providers.name: Samtrafiken
providers.description: Samtrafiken i Sverige AB is a Swedish public transport collaboration platform that aggregates and distributes timetable, ticketing and service data from multiple operators. It provides open traffic data through its Trafiklab portal, enabling developers and innovators to build applications that improve sustainable travel. The organization also offers services like Resplus for combined travel solutions and supports operators with data management tools. Recent initiatives include the ARTUR project for automated schedule updates, reflecting its commitment to modernizing transport information.

providers.name: Sveriges Radio
providers.description: Sveriges Radio is Sweden’s national publicly funded radio broadcasting organization, providing news, music, culture and educational programming across multiple channels and digital platforms. It operates several national and regional stations, offers podcasts, live streaming, and a comprehensive news service. The organization also provides open data and APIs for program schedules, news feeds, and media assets, supporting developers and researchers in accessing public broadcasting content.

providers.name: Insurello
providers.description: Insurello is a Swedish digital claims service that helps individuals obtain compensation from insurance after accidents or injuries. The platform offers a free case initiation, takes a 35% fee on successful payouts (capped at 35,000 SEK), and provides ongoing case updates via a personal dashboard and email. It covers personal injury, traffic accidents, sports injuries, work injuries, and assault, but not theft or loss. Insurello aims to simplify the claims process and increase success rates for claimants.

providers.name: Karolinska Institutet
providers.description: Karolinska Institutet (KI) is a world‑leading medical university in Stockholm, Sweden, focused on education, research and innovation in health and medicine. It operates a large network of hospitals, conducts Nobel‑prize‑winning biomedical research, and offers extensive academic programmes. KI provides open data portals, research APIs, and digital services for students, staff and collaborators, reflecting its commitment to transparency and scientific advancement.

providers.name: Hemnet
providers.description: Hemnet is Sweden’s leading online real‑estate marketplace, connecting home buyers with property listings across the country. The platform aggregates listings from real‑estate agents, providing detailed property information, photos, price history, and neighborhood data. Users can search, filter, and save favorite homes, while agents use Hemnet’s tools to showcase properties and reach a broad audience. Hemnet’s API enables developers to integrate property data into applications, offering endpoints for search, property details, and market statistics, supporting innovative real‑estate solutions and data‑driven insights.

providers.name: Edgeware
providers.description: Edgeware AB was a Swedish video-delivery technology company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Stockholm, known for its TV CDN, origin and media server, and streaming video-delivery products used by telecom operators and broadcasters to run OTT and IPTV services. Backed by Creandum, it listed on Nasdaq Stockholm in 2016 and was acquired by Agile Content (Agile Content S.A.) in 2020. The Edgeware brand has since been consolidated into AgileTV: edgeware.tv now redirects to agiletv.com/edgeware/, and its developer/technical documentation lives under docs.agilecontent.com (AgileTV Origin & Media Server, CDN Solutions, Subtitling). Edgeware no longer operates as an independent company or publishes an independent developer API surface.

providers.name: Apoteket
providers.description: Apoteket is Sweden’s leading pharmacy retailer, operating a nationwide chain of pharmacies and an extensive online store. Founded in 1971, it is a state‑owned enterprise that provides prescription medicines, over‑the‑counter products, health advice, and digital services such as e‑prescriptions and home delivery. The company reinvests profits into public health, education, and social care, reflecting its public‑service mission. Apoteket’s digital platforms offer APIs for product catalogs, order management, and customer accounts, supporting integration with healthcare providers and third‑party services.

providers.name: Avanza
providers.description: Avanza is a Swedish online stock broker and financial services platform offering trading, savings, and investment products to private investors. The company provides a modern web and mobile experience, extensive market data, and a range of APIs for account information, trading, and portfolio management. Avanza aims to democratize investing with low fees and user-friendly tools, serving millions of customers across Sweden.

providers.name: Ericsson
providers.description: Ericsson (Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson) is a Swedish multinational networking and telecommunications equipment vendor headquartered in Kista, Stockholm. Founded in 1876, the company supplies mobile and fixed network infrastructure to communication service providers worldwide and operates across three product areas: Networks (5G RAN, 5G Core, Cloud RAN, transport), Cloud Software & Services (OSS/BSS, orchestration, billing, charging, analytics), and Enterprise Wireless Solutions (private 5G via Cradlepoint). Ericsson holds more than 60,000 granted patents and operates 21 R&D centers, with networks that carry roughly 40 percent of the world's mobile data traffic. In 2024 Ericsson and twelve major operators — AT&T, Bharti Airtel, Deutsche Telekom, KDDI, Orange, Reliance Jio, Singtel, Telefonica, Telstra, T-Mobile, Verizon, and Vodafone — closed Aduna, a 50:50 joint venture that aggregates CAMARA-aligned network APIs (SIM Swap, Number Verification, Quality on Demand, Device Location, Device Reachability, Scam Signal, Call Forwarding Signal, Connectivity Insights, OTP SMS) and exposes them through hyperscaler and CPaaS channel partners (Microsoft Azure Marketplace, Google Cloud, Vonage, Sinch, Infobip). Ericsson also owns Vonage (acquired 2022), which operates the public-facing developer portal for many of these network capabilities, and runs the Ericsson Intelligent Automation Platform (EIAP) for ORAN-aligned rApp development. Ericsson does not publish a single consolidated developer portal or canonical OpenAPI catalog at ericsson.com — its programmable surface is delivered indirectly through Aduna, Vonage, and channel partners, and most of its public GitHub presence is research tooling and infrastructure software (CodeChecker, CodeCompass, ecchronos) rather than developer-facing APIs.

providers.name: H&M
providers.description: A Swedish multinational fast-fashion retailer offering affordable clothing, accessories, and home goods. Operates thousands of stores globally and is one of the world's largest fashion companies. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located on hm.com or hmgroup.com.

providers.name: PaceMaker
providers.description: PaceMaker is the consumer DJ application from Pacemaker Music AB, a Swedish startup and 500 Global portfolio company, that lets anyone mix and mash millions of tracks on iPhone and iPad. It connects to streaming catalogs such as Spotify, includes an AI DJ that suggests matching tracks and beat-matched transitions, and lets users crop and blend songs at phrase, bar, and beat precision to record and share their own mixtapes. Pacemaker is a mobile end-user product; as of this pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal, and its domain (pacemaker.net) currently serves a WordPress marketing blog.

providers.name: Folksam
providers.description: Folksam Försäkringsbolag is a Swedish insurance company offering a wide range of insurance products for homes, cars, and individuals, as well as savings and pension solutions. It serves over 900,000 vehicles and countless households across Sweden, emphasizing customer service and digital accessibility through its website.

providers.name: Stockholm stad
providers.description: Stockholm stad is the municipal government of Sweden’s capital city, providing a wide range of public services, open data portals, and digital tools for residents and businesses. The city’s website offers information on education, transportation, urban planning, social services, cultural events, and e‑services such as permits, registrations, and contact centers. This profile aims to capture the APIs that power these digital services and support developers in building applications that interact with Stockholm’s public sector data.

providers.name: Bankgirot
providers.description: Bankgirot is Sweden’s central clearing house for bank payments, operating a nationwide payment infrastructure that connects banks, businesses and public sector entities. It provides services such as BGC Invoice validation, automated payroll, direct debits, and electronic invoicing, supporting both private and corporate customers. The organization focuses on modernising payment flows, ensuring security, and offering APIs for integration with banking systems and third‑party providers.

providers.name: Stockholm Exergi
providers.description: Stockholm Exergi is a Swedish energy company providing district heating, cooling and electricity to the Stockholm region. It operates a modern, sustainable energy system, focusing on circular heat solutions, renewable energy integration, and carbon reduction. The company serves residential, commercial and industrial customers, offering transparent pricing, digital services, and a commitment to environmental responsibility. Through its extensive network, Stockholm Exergi aims to deliver reliable, efficient energy while supporting Sweden’s climate goals.

providers.name: Acne Studios
providers.description: Acne Studios is a Stockholm-based fashion house founded in 1996 as part of the creative collective ACNE (Ambition to Create Novel Expressions). The company designs and sells ready-to-wear womenswear and menswear, footwear, leather goods, denim, and accessories through its global network of retail stores and its official e-commerce site at acnestudios.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Acne Studios publishes no public developer API program or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and live domain-security posture. Sector: consumer / fashion retail.

providers.name: Apotea
providers.description: Apotea is a Swedish online pharmacy offering a wide range of medicines, health and beauty products. The site provides fast, free shipping and a user-friendly shopping experience, with categories covering dermatology, allergy, eye care, and more. It operates under Swedish regulations and is listed on the Swedish Medicines Agency site. The company’s digital presence includes extensive product listings, a premium service, and a dedicated customer support portal.

providers.name: Avida Holding
providers.description: Avida Holding AB operates as a holding company providing financial services including corporate and consumer lending solutions across Sweden, Norway, and Finland. Through its subsidiaries it offers mortgage loans, invoice factoring, and other credit products, aiming to enable customers to access easy financing and improve financial wellbeing. The company is backed by investors such as KKR and focuses on growth through customer‑centric, solution‑oriented culture.

providers.name: Bluebook
providers.description: Bluebook is a Stockholm, Sweden based software company building AI agents for accounting firms, accountants, and CFOs. The platform automates accounting workflows — reconciliations, accruals, accounts payable and receivable, month-end close, reporting, and accounting research — with the stated goal of a "zero-day close", and integrates with the general ledgers firms already run on, notably QuickBooks and NetSuite. The product surface is organized around Background Agents, Checklists (tasks, delegation, human-in-the-loop approvals, month-end close), and an Assistant covering FP&A, flux analysis, and accounting research. Founded in 2024 by Philip Andersson (CEO), Jonathan Andersson (COO), and Filip Stål (CTO), Bluebook went through Y Combinator (Winter 2025) and raised a $3M pre-seed led by EQT Ventures with participation from Y Combinator and angel investors from Affirm, OpenAI, and ElevenLabs. Bluebook is a product company, not an API provider: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, machine-readable specification, or SDKs.

providers.name: Bosonic
providers.description: Bosonic is a venture and consulting collective based in Sweden, dedicated to bringing great products to life through experimentation, iteration, and autonomy over hierarchy. The team offers software development, product ownership, and consultancy across sectors, emphasizing pragmatism, continuous self‑improvement, and innovative solutions for partners such as Womni, Manwell, and Finanzero.

providers.name: Na Kd
providers.description: Na Kd (NA-KD) is a Swedish online fashion retailer for women, selling clothing, shoes, and accessories direct-to-consumer through na-kd.com. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead, backed by Northzone and Partech. As of this enrichment pass NA-KD publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures the company identity and its live domain-security posture.

providers.name: Betsson
providers.description: Betsson AB is a leading online gaming group headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It owns fast‑growing companies in the online gambling sector and operates across multiple markets. Betsson focuses on profitable, sustainable growth and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm Large Cap. The group emphasizes responsible gaming, sustainability, and strong corporate governance, offering a range of betting, casino, and sports‑book services worldwide.

providers.name: Handelsbanken
providers.description: Handelsbanken is a leading Swedish bank offering a wide range of financial services, including personal banking, corporate banking, loans, mortgages, and investment solutions. The bank emphasizes digital transformation and provides APIs for developers to integrate banking functionalities such as account information, transaction history, and payment initiation. As part of its commitment to open banking, Handelsbanken supports secure, standards‑based interfaces that enable fintechs and partners to build innovative financial applications while adhering to strong security and compliance standards.

providers.name: Kameo
providers.description: Kameo is a Swedish fintech platform that connects real‑estate developers and growth companies with thousands of investors to finance property projects. It offers innovative loan products, an auto‑invest feature, and a transparent marketplace for both developers seeking capital and investors seeking returns, positioning itself as a leading Scandinavian alternative to traditional bank financing.

providers.name: Norstel
providers.description: Norstel AB was a Swedish semiconductor materials company that produced silicon carbide (SiC) wafers for power electronics, high-frequency and high-temperature electronics, and sensors, using its patented High Temperature Chemical Vapor Deposition (HTCVD) crystal-growth technology. Backed by Creandum among other investors, Norstel was acquired by STMicroelectronics in December 2019 and folded into ST's silicon carbide operations; it no longer operates as an independent company. As a hardware and materials manufacturer, Norstel published no developer platform, API, or SDK, so this API Evangelist record is an identity-only profile with no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Cult of the North
providers.description: Cult of the North (established November 2022 under the codename "Seidr") is a Stockholm, Sweden-based video game studio co-founded by former EA general manager Adam Schaub and former King SVP Marcus Jacobs, and backed by a seed investment from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). The studio drew talent from King, Activision Blizzard, EA, Embark Studios, Resolution Games, and FunPlus, and set out to build large-scale, next-generation multiplayer PvP experiences for PC and console in Unreal Engine 5 — first the debut title codenamed "Project Gundalf" and later the free-to-play strategy war game "We Will Be Gods." As a consumer game studio it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile carries company identity only. Industry reporting in 2025 indicated the studio wound down operations.

providers.name: Tenet Industries
providers.description: Tenet Industries is a Swedish defense-technology startup founded in 2026 by Hugo Frisk, Fabian Andersson, and Emil Falk (students from KTH Royal Institute of Technology and the Stockholm School of Economics) building low-cost, mass-producible defense systems. Applying design-for-manufacturing and first-principles engineering, the company starts with strike/attack drones — a kamikaze quadcopter that assembles in two minutes with roughly half the parts of comparable systems — and extends the same hardware/software platform to loitering munitions, jammers, radars, and missile systems. Backed by Y Combinator ($500K). As a defense hardware manufacturer, Tenet Industries currently publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Post- och telestyrelsen
providers.description: Post- och telestyrelsen (PTS) is Sweden’s national authority for electronic communications and postal services. It regulates, supervises and promotes a secure, accessible communications market, offering e‑services, managing spectrum, and ensuring compliance with digital standards. The agency provides public information, news, and various digital tools for operators and citizens.

providers.name: SEB
providers.description: SEB (Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken) is a leading Nordic financial services group offering banking, investment, and insurance solutions. Based in Sweden, SEB provides personal and corporate banking, loans, mortgages, savings, and digital payment services, serving customers across the region with a focus on innovation and security.

providers.name: Carrinetab
providers.description: Carrinetab is a Swedish‑based consumer‑goods company focused on reducing plastic waste through reusable retail packaging solutions. Founded in 2016, the firm designs and manufactures durable alternatives to single‑use plastics, targeting both B2B retailers and end‑consumers. Their product line includes reusable bags, containers, and custom‑branded packaging aimed at promoting sustainability across supply chains. Carrinetab operates internationally with offices in Gothenburg and Miami, leveraging eco‑friendly materials and circular‑economy principles to help brands transition away from disposable packaging.

providers.name: Campanja
providers.description: Campanja was a Stockholm-based advertising-technology company founded in 2010 that built a high-frequency paid-search bid-optimization engine. Its platform placed millions of automated bids per day across Google AdWords, Google Shopping, and Yahoo/Bing search campaigns, using real-time tracking and predictive big-data modeling to improve return on ad spend for large online advertisers while cutting media cost. Campanja raised a $5M Series A (Hoxton Ventures, DFJ Esprit) and was acquired by [24]7.ai in 2015, where its technology was folded into the [24]7 Customer Acquisition Cloud. The independent company is effectively defunct and campanja.com no longer resolves to a live site. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and processed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.
